### (e) Selection rule (G.8) and the P-70 pre-commitment that applies

FACT — source: report.json → `selection` (`complete`, `arms_considered`, `stopped_arms`, `rows`, `selected`, `note`), `arms.<arm>.signals`, `.class_stats_max`, `.turner_E1-2_Nm`; branch logic: `er9g_writeup.p70_branch` applying DECISION_LOG P-70 to those fields.

| Arm | Meets all four | Median E1-2 turner (N·m) | Magnets |
|---|---|---|---|
| PG8 | no | 0.378 | 64 |
| PG20 | no | 0.576 | 88 |

- Probe complete: yes. **Selected: none.** Note (report): no arm meets all four signals: Part G ends with the probe report; the next step goes to the user.
- Rule (G.8): among PG8 and PG20, the arm that meets all four signals with the lowest median E1-2 turner torque; ties to fewer magnets. If none meets all four, Part G ends with the probe report and the next step goes to the user. Fit does not enter selection.

| Pre-commitment | Text (DECISION_LOG P-70) | Status | From fields |
|---|---|---|---|
| P-70 item 1 | if neither arm meets all four probe signals, the only follow-up probe is PG20 at N42 and N35 under the same signals and selection rule, after one PG20 snap-back diagnostic | **applies** | selection.selected is null: no arm meets all four signals |
| P-70 item 2 | if signal 4 fails only through cross-type or off-path pairs, any further force-law check uses the envelope fixed from P1 (cross-type pairs 4.25-8 mm, path deviation up to 10.4 deg), not one fitted to the probe's poses, and L0's 12.59 deg in ER7 is first located by sub-experiment | does not apply | PG8: signal 4 met; PG20: signal 4 met (envelope: P1 `e15_like.combined.stats` `X_min_centre_distance_mm` and `PC_max_path_dev_deg`, table (a)) |
| P-70 item 3 | before G.9's full rehearsal, pause for the user if the selected arm's median E1-2 turner torque is >= 0.45 N.m or any move reaches the 1 N.m clip; the arm not selected gets no full rehearsal | does not apply | no arm selected |
